name: Universal Design Principles
description: A working library of 42 design principles drawn from Universal Principles of Design (Lidwell, Holden, Butler) and the broader HCI research literature. Install one or more of the five composable plugins and your Claude agent gains 137 curated skills that fire automatically during any UX, UI, or product design task. The principles apply across design systems, frameworks, and platforms.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install universal-design-principles@claude-community` from `HDeibler/universal-design-principles`.

**A cross-agent skill marketplace of 42 framework-agnostic UX & product-design principles, drawn from *Universal Principles of Design* (Lidwell, Holden, Butler, 2003) and the broader design and HCI research literature.**
